input.question: q-C-06
input.text: When does a customer get provisional credit on a dispute?

clauses.text: Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute.
clauses.title: Debit Card Dispute Policy

clauses.text: Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute.
clauses.title: Investigating a Dispute

clauses.text: Provisional credit is issued within 5 business days of receiving a completed dispute.
clauses.title: Large Dispute Review

clauses.text: Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute, whatever its review status.
clauses.title: Large Dispute Review

clauses.text: Provisional credit deadline for disputes | 5 business days
clauses.title: Dispute Intake Checklist
